summary.what_it_is: A cross-platform CLI and C library that lets AI agents see and control desktop applications by reading the OS accessibility tree (macOS, Windows, Linux) and returning JSON with actionable element references.
summary.why_trending: Growing interest in AI agents that can operate desktop apps without screenshots or pixel matching, and this project provides a ready-to-use accessibility-based approach for multiple platforms.
summary.who_its_for: Developers building AI agents that need to interact with desktop applications on macOS, Windows, or Linux.
